title: Rossini - William Tell Overture (military band transcription by Wenzel Sedlak)
performer: United States Marine Band, Timothy W. Foley, director (Grand Scenes, recorded June 5-9, 2000)
format: Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz, stereo, about 160 kbps
license: Public domain: a work of the US military (PD-USGov-Military-Marines); the composition and the 19th-century Sedlak transcription are also public domain. Credit the performance, but do not imply endorsement: the Marine Band's name is a trademark.
notes: Full overture. The Ranz des vaches starts at about 5:14 and the finale at about 7:30; the excerpt is the finale.

excerpt.notes: Trumpet fanfare, galop and coda. Starts in the rest before the fanfare (the exact fanfare entry was not confirmed by ear, so a few seconds of the end of the pastorale may lead in). Two joins skip a repeat of the galop theme and the quieter middle strain; each lands where the music repeats (onset correlation 0.88 and 0.61).
